statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH (yellow). NQ has retraced about 110 points off the 29,231.00 session low to 29,341.75, down 107.75 points or 0.37%, recovering the 29,308.50 shelf that broke two hours ago, while ES trades 7,666.50 above its own unchanged 7,645.25 low. VIX has decayed from its 18.03 session high to 17.42 and the 10-year at 5.02%, the 2-year at 4.67% and the 30-year at 5.38% have each eased a basis point or two, so Tail steps down from 24 to 20 and Stress from 75 to 73.
recommendation: Tail at 20 maps to WATCH for both NQ futures and the NAS100 CFD, five points below the block threshold. The step down records a completed retracement rather than a general improvement in tone. The framework treats repeated extension after failed retracements as the qualifying Tail structure, and this hour delivered the opposite: the 29,231.00 low has now held roughly two hours, price has recovered the broken 29,308.50 shelf from below, and two independent quote sources put NQ at 29,341.75 and 29,340.25 within the same minute. Every cross-asset amplifier that aligned into the break has eased rather than intensified, with VIX 0.61 off its high and the whole Treasury curve marginally lower. Stress remains high at 73 because none of the structural drivers has resolved: the 10-year sits near 5%, WTI holds 103.54 with the Saudi East-West pipeline still shut after fresh Gulf strikes, and the FOMC decision, projections and press conference arrive tomorrow. A danger window is declared from 13:00 to 15:00 UTC around the 13:30 UTC cash open, where conditional Tail peaks at 25. That peak sits at the bottom of the elevated band because no opening structure has been observed and Monday's cash session recovered more than 259 points from its low.
headline: NQ retraces 110 points off the 29,231.00 low and recovers the broken shelf as VIX decays to 17.42 - Tail eases to 20 while Stress stays high at 73 into FOMC eve
body:
The development of this hour is a completed retracement. NQ trades 29,341.75, down 107.75 points or 0.37% against a 29,449.50 prior close, having recovered roughly 110 points from the 29,231.00 low set two hours ago. That move has carried price back above the 29,308.50 shelf whose break defined the previous two assessments, so the structure that drove Tail to 25 at 08:00 UTC has been repaired rather than extended. A second independent source puts the same contract at 29,340.25, down 0.37%, against the identical 29,231.00 low, so the price path is corroborated rather than single-sourced.

ES confirms. It trades 7,666.50, down 0.34%, roughly 21 points above its 7,645.25 low, which is unchanged from two hours ago. Neither index future has made a new low since 09:00 UTC and both have now put distance between price and the session extreme. The framework's qualifying Tail structure is repeated extension after failed retracements; this hour produced a successful retracement instead, which is the specific evidence that allows Tail to fall.

The cross-asset picture has eased in the same direction. VIX is 17.42, down 0.61 from the 18.03 session high and trading at the lower end of its 17.40 to 18.03 range. The US 10-year is 5.02%, the 2-year 4.67% and the 30-year 5.38%, each a basis point or two below the prior hour, so the long-end repricing that has driven this episode has paused. WTI at 103.54 and Brent at 107.35 are close to unchanged on the hour.

Stress stays high at 73 because none of that is resolution. The 10-year remains near 5%, its highest in years, on surging energy prices and fiscal concerns. The Saudi East-West pipeline, which can carry 7 million barrels a day and bypasses the Strait of Hormuz, remains shut after drone damage, with fresh Houthi strikes reported today and repair estimates ranging from very soon to eight weeks. Public commentary from several AI-company leaders calling for slower frontier-model development continues to weigh on megacap and semiconductor tone. Tomorrow brings Retail Sales at 12:30 UTC and the Federal Reserve decision, economic projections and press conference from 18:00 UTC.

The conditional path therefore separates the two measures. Tail decays with the session clock through the US afternoon and overnight, bottoming at 17 in the Asian session, then rebuilds to 23 by the end of the horizon on FOMC morning. Stress follows the same shape at a much higher level, never falling below 66. The declared 13:00 to 15:00 UTC danger window is the one span where conditional Tail reaches the elevated band, and it is tied specifically to the unobserved cash open rather than to the day's general tone.

lookbackSummary: The published record covers all 24 preceding clock hours with no gaps. Tail ran 20 to 26 through Monday's European and US morning, peaking at 26 at the US cash open, then decayed through the US afternoon to 15 and to a 14 trough in the Asian session as price discovery turned orderly. It re-accelerated to 24 at 05:00 UTC when NQ first broke the 29,426.75 shelf with both index futures at extremes, eased to 20 and 21 through the European pre-open as a retracement resolved that structure, and reached 25 at 08:00 UTC when the subsequent floor also failed, before easing to 24 at 09:00 UTC as the new low held. Stress held a 65 to 79 band throughout, reflecting a rate and energy backdrop that never reset. Confidence stayed between 86 and 89 on continuously available price-path evidence.
outlookSummary: The conditional path holds 20 for the remainder of this hour and across the 11:00 UTC European lull, with a fresh probe below 29,231.00 named as the invalidation. It ticks to 22 for the 12:15 and 12:30 UTC releases and peaks at 25 across the declared 13:00 to 15:00 UTC danger window covering the US cash open and the first full cash hour. That peak sits at the bottom of the elevated band because no opening structure has been observed and Monday's cash session recovered more than 259 points from its low. It steps down to 23 and 22 through the US afternoon, returns to 23 for the 17:00 UTC 20-year bond auction given the long-end repricing, and eases through 22, 21 and 20 into the 20:00 UTC cash close. Overnight, conditional Tail decays through 19 and 18 to a 17 trough across the Asian session, then rebuilds through 18, 19 and 20 into the European pre-open of FOMC day, reaching 22 at the European cash open and 23 at the 09:00 UTC horizon limit. Conditional Stress tracks the same shape far higher, troughing at 66 overnight and rebuilding to 76 as the decision, projections and press conference stack into Wednesday afternoon. Confidence decays from 88 to 71 with the forecast horizon.
